India to Face England in Final Match of 5-Tournament T20 Series

The Indian cricket team will face off against England in the final match of their 5-tournament T20 series. The series has already been won by England, and India is looking to end on a high note. The weather forecast for the match suggests that there is a chance of rain, which could impact the outcome of the game.
